caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic branding iron displayed horizontally across a plain, light-colored background. The branding iron is primarily brown with some shading to indicate its metallic texture. Its handle is elongated and cylindrical, ending in a circular loop. The working end of the branding iron is shaped in a stylized "Z" form, with the lines appearing flattened where the metal would be pressed against a surface. Below the branding iron is a reddish-brown mark, shown as two parallel horizontal lines with a diagonal connecting line, representing the imprint created by the iron. The imprint is shown in a lighter shade compared to the branding iron itself. A small signature, "Elizabeth Robinson," is visible in the bottom left corner of the drawing, and the word "Top" is written vertically along the left edge. The image is framed by a thin rectangular line close to the edge of the paper.
title: Branding Iron
